purpose: Teach: 主席/報復/紫外線/盗聴/衰え/反抗/自閉症/射撃

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、主席卒業者の追跡調査を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on tracking outcomes of top-ranked graduates, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, gentle. A teacher's genuine recall — she's looked over Sakura's work. Clear, unhurried pacing. A small smile in the voice: genuine interest, not interrogation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、国家間の報復措置を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on retaliatory measures between states.
lines.style: Direct, composed. Sakura sitting up slightly — ready to defend her work. No apology in the voice. Even tempo, meeting the question head-on.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 紫外線が皮膚に与える影響を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And the effects of ultraviolet exposure on skin — that was one of your topics too?
lines.style: Gentle check-in. A teacher thinking aloud, reflecting. Slightly questioning lift at the end — she's verifying her own memory. Unhurried, warm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、盗聴の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote on the history of wiretapping.
lines.style: Clear and steady. Sakura meeting the teacher's gaze without hesitation. Not defensive — just stating fact. Slight emphasis on the specificity of the topic.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 帝国の衰えを論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: The decline of empires — you explored that angle as well?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly wondering. Teacher recognizing a thread in the student's thinking. Warm but genuinely curious. Paced like she's piecing something together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、青年期の反抗心理を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined adolescent psychology of rebellion.
lines.style: Confident and clear. Sakura's voice steady. A slight ownership in how she frames it — not just 'I wrote about' but claiming the analytical lens. Direct eye contact in tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 自閉症スペクトラムの研究を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And autism spectrum research — that was your paper as well?
lines.style: Engaged, present. Teacher leaning in slightly. Noticing something — a pattern, a depth. Curious without pressure. The lilt of genuine interest, not checking a box.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、射撃競技の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered the history of competitive shooting.
lines.style: Final answer, grounded. Sakura meeting the teacher's eye one last time. Quiet confidence. A small close to the exchange — settled, assured, not rushed.
